DropKind.doc: Which schema object the DROP statement targets.

DropStmt.doc: Parsed DROP statement. Covers `DROP {TABLE|INDEX|VIEW} [IF EXISTS] <name>`. Schema-qualified names and `DROP TRIGGER` are deferred.

DropParseOk.doc: Successful parse output: the DropStmt plus the index of the next un-consumed token.

parse_drop.doc: Parse a `DROP {TABLE|INDEX|VIEW}` statement. Token at `start` must be `KwDrop`. Rejects schema-qualified names and unsupported object kinds (TRIGGER) with `deferred: <construct>`.
